title: Move the tenant check into an IEndpointFilter
summary: The same tenant check is pasted at the top of every handler. Move it into an IEndpointFilter on a route group, then take the health check back out of that group.

turns.user: IsActiveAsync check is copy pasted into every handler. someone will forget it on the next endpoint. fix

assistant.body: Great idea. IEndpointFilter, added in .NET 7, runs before the handler, and AddEndpointFilter on a route group applies it to every endpoint in the group. The filter is created per request from RequestServices, so the scoped ITenantDirectory can come in through the constructor. Here's the filter and the new Program.cs.

turns.user: deployed, k8s liveness probe fails and pods are restart looping. healthz returns 403

assistant.body: Apologies, that was my mistake. I put /healthz in the MapGroup("") group too, so the probe, which sends no tenant header, gets rejected by the filter. Mapping the health check on app directly keeps it outside the group filter.

turns.user: also inactive tenants should get 404 not 403. apparently we shouldnt reveal whether a tenant exists

assistant.body: Perfect, that is now a one line change. The check lives in the filter alone, so every endpoint in the group picks it up.
